bullets.text: Pattabiram residents urged the Highways Department to build a roundabout on the CTH Road junction, and the office should monitor traffic safety measures.
Around 1500 daily passengers at Ambattur railway station still await a fourth platform after 30 years, so the office should check railway expansion plans.
Thousands of devotees waited three hours for darshan at the Thiruttani temple, and the office should review crowd management facilities there.
An editorial noted that pervasive artificial intelligence poses an existential challenge redefining human rules, and the ministry should watch broader policy discussions.

stories.title: Pattabiram residents urge Highways dept. to build roundabouton CTH Road junction
takeaways: Pattabiram residents requested the Highways Department to construct a roundabout on the CTH Road junction.
The new structure aims to replace Level Crossing 2 and ease traffic congestion near the flyover.

stories.title: 30 years on, Ambattur railway station still awaits fourth platform
takeaways: Around 1500 daily passengers face inconvenience due to the missing fourth platform at Ambattur railway station.
Commuters urge railway authorities to expedite the long-delayed infrastructure upgrade connecting key regional routes.

takeaways: Thousands of devotees gathered at the famous Thiruttani Murugan Temple on Saturday to offer prayers.
Worshippers had to wait for nearly three hours in queues before having darshan of the deity.

stories.title: Editorial: Return of the “human”
takeaways: An analytical editorial examined the existential challenges posed by pervasive artificial intelligence in modern society.
The article questions the redefined meaning of human identity as machine intelligence rapidly expands its influence.
